recall.evidence: jarvos_recall through the Muse read-only gateway (query, includeQmd, autoGraph only)

startupHydration.reason: Muse runs on a separate computer with no session-start hook into the Muse host; automatic startup hydration would target the wrong lifecycle. Hydrate manually with the jarvos_hydrate tool.

declare.reason: No public Muse egress declaration is shipped.

receive.reason: jarvOS does not expose SendMessage or CloudAgent from this adapter.

validate.reason: jarvOS does not expose SendMessage or CloudAgent from this adapter.

receipt.reason: No public Muse lifecycle receipt bridge is declared.

create.reason: The Muse read-only gateway denies jarvos_create_note; note capture is not exposed to Muse.

journalLink.reason: The Muse read-only gateway exposes no capture path, so no journal links are written.

read.evidence: read-only tools over HTTP; no raw vault file access from the Muse host
read.transport: jarvos_recall MCP tool through the Muse read-only gateway

update.reason: The Muse read-only gateway denies every write tool, including session-thread writes.

handoff.reason: The Muse read-only gateway denies session-thread writes and reads; jarvos_hydrate may include session-thread context but Muse cannot hand off.

startupHook.reason: startupHydration is unsupported; there is no Muse startup hook on the vault host.

discover.reason: Skill projection is out of scope; the skills manager does not project to Muse and the read-only gateway denies jarvos_shared_skills.

invoke.reason: Skill projection is out of scope; the skills manager does not project to Muse.

declare.reason: No public Muse authorization contract is shipped.

delivery.reason: Local owner configuration chooses a delivery surface; this public adapter does not configure one.

hydration.command: After the remote connector is reachable, call the jarvos_hydrate MCP tool at session start.
hydration.reason: startupHydration is unsupported because Muse is a separate computer from the canonical vault.

mcp.registration: On the VAULT HOST run runtimes/muse/gateway.js (read-only Streamable HTTP in front of jarvos-mcp.js; default 127.0.0.1:8766; Muse-only token via JARVOS_MUSE_MCP_TOKEN_FILE). It exposes exactly jarvos_hydrate, jarvos_projects_context, jarvos_recall and jarvos_startup_brief with closed argument schemas; prompts, resources, writes and GET SSE are denied. On the Muse host register only the reachable Muse gateway URL plus the Muse bearer token. Never point Muse at the general jarvos-mcp-http.js gateway and never reuse its credential. Do not register stdio MCP on the Muse host disk; that hydrates the wrong machine.

unsupportedCapabilities.reason: Automatic session-start hydration is unsupported; Muse hydrates manually per session with jarvos_hydrate.
The Muse read-only gateway denies note capture, note updates and session-thread writes.
No handoff: session-thread writes are denied by the Muse read-only gateway.
The skills manager does not project to Muse; jarvos_shared_skills is denied by the read-only gateway.
The Muse read-only gateway advertises tools only; prompts such as boot_jarvos are denied.
